label: Average annual temperature

source.name: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal / CRU

measurement: Nationally aggregated annual mean surface air temperature for the 1991–2020 climate normal. This is a long-run climate average, not the current weather or a forecast. Values were read from period-labelled official country-profile text or tables.

license.name: CC BY 4.0 for CCKP datasets unless specifically labelled otherwise; underlying CRU metadata cites the UK Open Government Licence v3
license.attribution: World Bank: Climate Change Knowledge Portal, CRU surface air temperature data; Climatic Research Unit (University of East Anglia) and Met Office. Extraction and ISO2 normalization by TerraScope.
license.note: CCKP has dataset-specific terms. The general World Bank website terms differ and must not be used to relabel a dataset. Preserve per-dataset notices when bulk data is materialized.

limitations: The official CCKP all_countries API was inaccessible through the available tool network. The included seed is intentionally incomplete.
Never compute or display a world rank from this eight-country seed. Show rank unavailable until a consistent global dataset is imported.
No interpolation, climate-zone proxy, capital-city average, or invented country value was used.
Do not merge profile averages with a different source period into this 1991–2020 layer.
